# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; master  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

During his farewell speech to his students, tears were visible in his eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is known for being horrid, sarcastic, and lacking proper discipline, frequently resorting to whipping his pupils while failing to maintain order in his classroom. He occasionally experiences spasmodic fits of reform, imposing strict rules and punishing latecomers. Despite his shortcomings, he displays an romantic side, occasionally drawing inspiration from books or writing verses for those he favors.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- horrid and sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- lacks control over his classroom  <sub>[v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- reciting dramatic speeches in heart-stirring tones  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the school teacher in Avonlea. During his tenure, he regularly instructed pupils such as Anne Shirley, Gilbert Blythe, and Prissy Andrews, though he often mortified and disciplined students harshly. He routinely spent time helping Prissy Andrews with her studies in the evenings and publicly favored her, giving her Mayflowers and sending away to town for carnations for her performance. Once, after whipping Sam Boulter for talking back in class, Sam's father came to the school and dared Mr. Phillips to lay a hand on his children again. At a local concert, he delivered Mark Antony's oration over the dead body of Caesar while continually looking at Prissy. At the end of his term, he delivered an affecting farewell speech that brought many of his students to tears, after which he left his position at the Avonlea school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
